sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Artist and label pictures from majkinetor's Event Horizon, when it is installed: an artist's or a label's window (Space) shows the pictures Event Horizon finds on Discogs, Deezer, Tidal, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, YouTube Music and Wikipedia after this script's own, in the order you set in Event Horizon. They are marked "via Event Horizon" under the large picture and with a small EH on their thumbnails, and the viewer links each provider's page. This script's pictures show at once; one line says while Event Horizon is still asking, and when it gives no answer this script's pictures stand alone, with nothing said. Event Horizon's Wikipedia picture is left out when the window already shows a Wikimedia Commons file. The card on hover and the picture beside an artist's or label's name show the picture Event Horizon already knows, without asking anybody; beside the name it joins the turn last, its dot ringed in blue. New setting: Also Event Horizon's pictures, when it is installed (on; it needs Pictures in artist, label and place previews, and the settings dialog greys it out while that one is off, with VZ_MBLibrary 4.6.0). This uses the shared lookup Event Horizon offers other scripts (MBU.artistImage, agreed on majkinetor/musicbrainz-userscripts #938).
